node.label: Defence & Internal Security
node.summary: Armed forces, defence production, policing, corruption cases and cyber security.

facts.text: Atmanirbhar defence: about 72 lakh person-days of direct jobs; the corvettes handle anti-submarine, anti-surface and coastal roles.
facts.plain: Atmanirbhar defence: about 72 lakh person-days of direct jobs; the corvettes handle anti-submarine, anti-surface and coastal roles.

facts.text: Contracts worth **₹53,866.50 crore** for **8 Next Generation Corvettes**: **GRSE** builds 5, **Goa Shipyard** 3. First Navy-designed warships built by Defence PSUs.
facts.plain: Contracts worth ₹53,866.50 crore for 8 Next Generation Corvettes: GRSE builds 5, Goa Shipyard 3. First Navy-designed warships built by Defence PSUs.

facts.text: **Sourabh Chandrakar**, promoter of the Mahadev Online Book illegal betting app (scam pegged at ₹6,000 crore, run via franchised 'panels' and 'branches'), was extradited to India from Oman following an Interpol Red Corner Notice, in a CBI-led operation.

facts.text: New IAF Chief Air Chief Marshal **Ashutosh Dixit** outlined the '**VAYU**' framework — Vigilance & readiness, Aatmanirbharta, Yukti (ingenuity) and Unity of effort — and adopted the motto '*Nabha Sparsham Deeptam*', prioritising the indigenous Tejas Mk1A/Mk2 and the AMCA.
facts.plain: New IAF Chief Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit outlined the 'VAYU' framework — Vigilance & readiness, Aatmanirbharta, Yukti (ingenuity) and Unity of effort — and adopted the motto '*Nabha Sparsham Deeptam*', prioritising the indigenous Tejas Mk1A/Mk2 and the AMCA.

facts.text: **Binance**, the world's largest crypto exchange, suffered a cyberattack on 29 October with losses estimated at over **$6.3 billion**; analytics firm Chainalysis attributed it to North Korea's Lazarus Group (via 'TraderTraitor'), similar to the 2024 WazirX hack ($235 million); stablecoin issuers Tether and Circle froze 1.567bn USDT and 800m USDC respectively.
facts.plain: Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, suffered a cyberattack on 29 October with losses estimated at over $6.3 billion; analytics firm Chainalysis attributed it to North Korea's Lazarus Group (via 'TraderTraitor'), similar to the 2024 WazirX hack ($235 million); stablecoin issuers Tether and Circle froze 1.567bn USDT and 800m USDC respectively.

facts.text: Samajwadi Party leader **Azam Khan** was sent to 14-day judicial custody by a special PMLA court in Ghaziabad in an ED money-laundering case based on 26 FIRs (2019) alleging forced occupation of farmers' land in Rampur for Mohammad Ali Jauhar University.
facts.plain: Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan was sent to 14-day judicial custody by a special PMLA court in Ghaziabad in an ED money-laundering case based on 26 FIRs (2019) alleging forced occupation of farmers' land in Rampur for Mohammad Ali Jauhar University.

facts.text: The Defence Acquisition Council gave in-principle approval to a **₹80,000-crore** next-generation guided-missile destroyer programme (Project 18A) with nearly 75% indigenous content, to be designed by the Navy's Warship Design Bureau, amid growing Chinese and Pakistani underwater-warfare capabilities.
facts.plain: The Defence Acquisition Council gave in-principle approval to a ₹80,000-crore next-generation guided-missile destroyer programme (Project 18A) with nearly 75% indigenous content, to be designed by the Navy's Warship Design Bureau, amid growing Chinese and Pakistani underwater-warfare capabilities.

facts.text: Air Chief Marshal **Ashutosh Dixit** assumed charge as the **29th Chief of the Air Staff** on **Saturday, 31 Oct**, succeeding **A.P. Singh** (43 years of service). A fighter pilot with **3,500+** flying hours, he was **Vice Chief** and helped plan **Operation Sindoor**.
facts.plain: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit assumed charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on Saturday, 31 Oct, succeeding A.P. Singh (43 years of service). A fighter pilot with 3,500+ flying hours, he was Vice Chief and helped plan Operation Sindoor.

facts.text: At **Ekta Nagar** (Gujarat) on Patel's 151st birth anniversary, PM Modi said his promise to free India of **Naxalism** had been fulfilled but warned of '**dimagi (intellectual) Naxals**'; next steps: securing borders, stopping infiltration and a **'secular civil code'**. He launched 31 projects worth **₹426.71 crore**.
facts.plain: At Ekta Nagar (Gujarat) on Patel's 151st birth anniversary, PM Modi said his promise to free India of Naxalism had been fulfilled but warned of 'dimagi (intellectual) Naxals'; next steps: securing borders, stopping infiltration and a 'secular civil code'. He launched 31 projects worth ₹426.71 crore.

facts.text: ED detained SP leader **Azam Khan** (78) outside **Rampur** jail right after he got bail in a PAN fraud case (he was later sent to judicial custody in a PMLA case).
facts.plain: ED detained SP leader Azam Khan (78) outside Rampur jail right after he got bail in a PAN fraud case (he was later sent to judicial custody in a PMLA case).

facts.text: Manipur: **COCOMI** (Meitei umbrella body) rallied in Imphal and Naga groups marched in Chandel and Senapati, demanding an end to the **Suspension of Operations (SoO)** pact with Kuki-Zo groups, which expired on **4 Sept**. Forces took over a designated camp where only **1 of 159** cadres was present and will audit all **14** camps.
facts.plain: Manipur: COCOMI (Meitei umbrella body) rallied in Imphal and Naga groups marched in Chandel and Senapati, demanding an end to the Suspension of Operations (SoO) pact with Kuki-Zo groups, which expired on 4 Sept. Forces took over a designated camp where only 1 of 159 cadres was present and will audit all 14 camps.

facts.text: ED's **Operation Trident** against a cross-border 'narco-hawala' network: raids at **38 locations** in **Assam, Mizoram and Manipur**, **18** arrests and **₹100 crore** of hawala transactions found on 23 Oct; four more held, including a Myanmar citizen.
facts.plain: ED's Operation Trident against a cross-border 'narco-hawala' network: raids at 38 locations in Assam, Mizoram and Manipur, 18 arrests and ₹100 crore of hawala transactions found on 23 Oct; four more held, including a Myanmar citizen.

facts.text: Kerala Crime Branch SIT filed an FIR against the chairperson (**M.R. Baiju**) and members of the **Kerala PSC** over alleged fraud in recruitment tests. State PSCs are constitutional bodies under **Article 315**.
facts.plain: Kerala Crime Branch SIT filed an FIR against the chairperson (M.R. Baiju) and members of the Kerala PSC over alleged fraud in recruitment tests. State PSCs are constitutional bodies under Article 315.

facts.text: **Sabarimala ghee scam**: the Vigilance probe found **11,000 kg** of **Milma** ghee was stolen and sold for ₹50 lakh, with ₹20 lakh shared among **Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB)** staff.
facts.plain: Sabarimala ghee scam: the Vigilance probe found 11,000 kg of Milma ghee was stolen and sold for ₹50 lakh, with ₹20 lakh shared among Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) staff.

facts.text: T.N. CM **C. Joseph Vijay** suspended Theni's in-charge jail superintendent after the 26 Oct jailbreak (17 escaped, all caught within 40 hours).
facts.plain: T.N. CM C. Joseph Vijay suspended Theni's in-charge jail superintendent after the 26 Oct jailbreak (17 escaped, all caught within 40 hours).

facts.text: The **NDPS Act, 1985** is India's main drug law; the **Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB)** was set up in **1986**. The 2018 national survey was AIIMS's *Magnitude of Substance Use in India* (2019) for the Social Justice Ministry. Punjab borders Pakistan near the **Golden Crescent**.
facts.plain: The NDPS Act, 1985 is India's main drug law; the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) was set up in 1986. The 2018 national survey was AIIMS's Magnitude of Substance Use in India (2019) for the Social Justice Ministry. Punjab borders Pakistan near the Golden Crescent.

facts.text: Punjab's anti-drug campaign **'Yudh Nashian Virudh'** reached its **606th day** on 29 Oct, with **88,979** alleged smugglers arrested. Punjab DGP: **Gaurav Yadav**. *Chitta* is slang for heroin.
facts.plain: Punjab's anti-drug campaign 'Yudh Nashian Virudh' reached its 606th day on 29 Oct, with 88,979 alleged smugglers arrested. Punjab DGP: Gaurav Yadav. Chitta is slang for heroin.

facts.text: **PANJ Foundation** report 'State of Punjab: Data Story of 15 Years' (using the 2018 national survey): cannabis use **12.55%**, **4.4 times** the national rate and the highest of **36 States/UTs**; opioids **4.7x**, cocaine **6.6x**, alcohol about 2x.
facts.plain: PANJ Foundation report 'State of Punjab: Data Story of 15 Years' (using the 2018 national survey): cannabis use 12.55%, 4.4 times the national rate and the highest of 36 States/UTs; opioids 4.7x, cocaine 6.6x, alcohol about 2x.

facts.text: Punjab anti-drug activist **Parvinder Singh Jhota** (40), founder of the 'Nasha Roko, Rozgaar Do' campaign (2023), was shot dead on **13 Oct** at a chemist shop in **Mansa**; his family's demand for a **CBI** probe was accepted.
facts.plain: Punjab anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota (40), founder of the 'Nasha Roko, Rozgaar Do' campaign (2023), was shot dead on 13 Oct at a chemist shop in Mansa; his family's demand for a CBI probe was accepted.

facts.text: Rajasthan put IPS officer **Prashakha Mathur** (1995 batch, ADG) on APO after an **ACB** probe was approved against her husband, IAS officer **Shikhar Agrawal**, over the purchase of **40 villas** in the family's names.
facts.plain: Rajasthan put IPS officer Prashakha Mathur (1995 batch, ADG) on APO after an ACB probe was approved against her husband, IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal, over the purchase of 40 villas in the family's names.

facts.text: **Army Day** is observed on **15 Jan**, when Gen. **K.M. Cariappa** took over as the first Indian Commander-in-Chief in **1949**; since 2023 the parade has been held outside Delhi (Bengaluru 2023, Lucknow 2024, Pune 2025).
facts.plain: Army Day is observed on 15 Jan, when Gen. K.M. Cariappa took over as the first Indian Commander-in-Chief in 1949; since 2023 the parade has been held outside Delhi (Bengaluru 2023, Lucknow 2024, Pune 2025).

facts.text: **Army Day 2027** is being linked to **Bhopal**: an Army-M.P. government 'Sankalp Vriksh' plantation drive with CM **Mohan Yadav** began on 1 Nov 2026 at **Shaurya Smarak**, Bhopal.
facts.plain: Army Day 2027 is being linked to Bhopal: an Army-M.P. government 'Sankalp Vriksh' plantation drive with CM Mohan Yadav began on 1 Nov 2026 at Shaurya Smarak, Bhopal.

facts.text: **Prisons** are a **State List** subject (Entry 4). The Centre circulated a **Model Prisons Act, 2023**; NCRB's Prison Statistics 2022 put national prison occupancy at about **131%**.
facts.plain: Prisons are a State List subject (Entry 4). The Centre circulated a Model Prisons Act, 2023; NCRB's Prison Statistics 2022 put national prison occupancy at about 131%.

facts.text: **17 remand prisoners** escaped from **Theni district jail** (Tamil Nadu) on 26 Oct and were caught within **42 hours** using drones; the jail built for 200 held **334**, with only 6 of 33 staff on duty. DGP (Prisons) Sandeep Rai Rathore was replaced by **K. Shankar**.
facts.plain: 17 remand prisoners escaped from Theni district jail (Tamil Nadu) on 26 Oct and were caught within 42 hours using drones; the jail built for 200 held 334, with only 6 of 33 staff on duty. DGP (Prisons) Sandeep Rai Rathore was replaced by K. Shankar.

facts.text: Editorial: the RBI's **2017 zero-liability circular** covers only unauthorised transactions, so victims coerced into transferring money get nothing; the new RBI KYC directions let banks hold unusual transactions of **₹1,000+** for up to **60 days**. Many scam compounds run from **Myanmar, Cambodia and Laos**.
facts.plain: Editorial: the RBI's 2017 zero-liability circular covers only unauthorised transactions, so victims coerced into transferring money get nothing; the new RBI KYC directions let banks hold unusual transactions of ₹1,000+ for up to 60 days. Many scam compounds run from Myanmar, Cambodia and Laos.

facts.text: Telangana Police arrested three for selling **83 mule bank accounts** (₹20,000-25,000 each) to cyber fraudsters; the accounts received about ₹10.05 crore.
facts.plain: Telangana Police arrested three for selling 83 mule bank accounts (₹20,000-25,000 each) to cyber fraudsters; the accounts received about ₹10.05 crore.

facts.text: Delhi HC sought the ED's response to **Lalu Prasad's** plea against money-laundering charges in the **IRCTC hotel** case (Sujata Hotels, 2004-14).
facts.plain: Delhi HC sought the ED's response to Lalu Prasad's plea against money-laundering charges in the IRCTC hotel case (Sujata Hotels, 2004-14).

facts.text: SC (Bench led by Justice **Prashant Kumar Mishra**) reserved verdict on the **ED's** plea for a CBI probe into alleged obstruction of its raids on political consultancy **I-PAC** (co-founder **Pratik Jain**) by then West Bengal CM **Mamata Banerjee**.

facts.plain: Committee on Tribal Unity (CoTU), a Kuki-Zomi body, called a 48-hour shutdown in Manipur's Kangpokpi district over the alleged abduction of two Kuki youth.

facts.text: The **NHRC** is a statutory body under the **Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993**; its chairperson is a former Chief Justice of India or former SC judge.
facts.plain: The NHRC is a statutory body under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993; its chairperson is a former Chief Justice of India or former SC judge.

facts.text: **NHRC** took suo motu cognisance of three men being paraded semi-naked in Kolkata's **Behala** and sought a report from the Kolkata Police Commissioner within two weeks.
facts.plain: NHRC took suo motu cognisance of three men being paraded semi-naked in Kolkata's Behala and sought a report from the Kolkata Police Commissioner within two weeks.

facts.text: Delhi Police arrested two men from **Mathura** who ran fake health camps to collect **Aadhaar** biometrics, used them to get SIM cards and sold them to cybercriminals (linked to 20+ frauds worth ₹2.64 crore).
facts.plain: Delhi Police arrested two men from Mathura who ran fake health camps to collect Aadhaar biometrics, used them to get SIM cards and sold them to cybercriminals (linked to 20+ frauds worth ₹2.64 crore).

facts.text: 'Digital arrest' is not a legal procedure: no law lets police or any agency arrest or question a person over a video or phone call. Victims can report on the cybercrime helpline **1930** or **cybercrime.gov.in**.
facts.plain: 'Digital arrest' is not a legal procedure: no law lets police or any agency arrest or question a person over a video or phone call. Victims can report on the cybercrime helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.

facts.text: Attorney-General **R. Venkataramani** told the SC the **RBI (Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026** will be notified by **30 Nov** and operational by **31 Dec**; banks must freeze transactions that deviate sharply from an account's history and alert police. The CJI called digital arrest 'the biggest financial fraud in the history of this country'.
facts.plain: Attorney-General R. Venkataramani told the SC the RBI (Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026 will be notified by 30 Nov and operational by 31 Dec; banks must freeze transactions that deviate sharply from an account's history and alert police. The CJI called digital arrest 'the biggest financial fraud in the history of this country'.

facts.text: SC (CJI **Surya Kant**) asked the **RBI** to make banks fully compensate **digital arrest** victims when the fraud succeeds through a lapse in the bank's diligence; over **₹800 crore** was lost to fraudsters posing as police/officials in a year. Amicus curiae: **N.S. Nappinai**.
facts.plain: SC (CJI Surya Kant) asked the RBI to make banks fully compensate digital arrest victims when the fraud succeeds through a lapse in the bank's diligence; over ₹800 crore was lost to fraudsters posing as police/officials in a year. Amicus curiae: N.S. Nappinai.
